Chapter 1139: 8: The Teleportation Of The Eye Of Myriad Laws (Requesting Subscription)

Chapter 1139: Chapter 8: The Teleportation of the Eye of Myriad Laws (Requesting Subscription)

They continued to chat for a few more sentences.

Ancient Ming Venerable then got up to say goodbye.

He had come specifically to inform Lin Yuan of this matter, purely for the sake of sharing information.

This was something Lin Yuan had entrusted him with before—

If anything major happened in the Chaos Void, remember to let him know.

Ancient Ming Venerable took this matter seriously, which is why he came as soon as possible.

After the Ancient Ming Venerable left.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged and fell into contemplation.

In the postnatal universe, the most valuable thing is none other than the exploration of the thirteenth level by supreme saints.

This is also the key to the madness of those Chaos Great Saints.

If one achieves perfection at the twelfth level and attempts the thirteenth level, perhaps gaining just a bit more insight, in the end, they could step into the thirteenth level.

But in Lin Yuan’s mind, this was just that.

In the source world, Lin Yuan could even come into contact with true time lifeforms of the thirteenth level,

and even possess them, experiencing the perspective and height of the thirteenth level.

Compared to the Chaos Great Saints and Supreme Saints of the Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan’s conditions were simply far superior.

And the commotion in that postnatal universe was so great that even Ancient Ming Venerable knew about it.

This basically meant it was spreading within the Chaos Realm circle, estimating that nearby great saints would flock there.

With great saints taking action, Lin Yuan did not think a postnatal universe from tens of thousands of Cosmic Eras ago could withstand for much time.

Even if he rushed there now, it would be meaningless. Hundreds of years later on arrival, the entire postnatal universe would probably be turned over, not even a drop of soup left.

“What a pity.” Lin Yuan looked at the beast skin in front of him, the map on it flickering with light.

Depending on the map on the beast skin, if Lin Yuan could reach that postnatal universe, he’d definitely have a great advantage, even with competition from other Chaos Great Saints.

In the end, he could probably obtain most of the resources left by His Majesty Xuanhuang within the postnatal universe.

His Majesty Xuanhuang’s exploration and insight into the thirteenth level, Lin Yuan was not as eager as those Chaos Great Saints, but the numerous resources, weapons, and treasures left by a supreme saint at the end…

Lin Yuan was still very interested in them.

Chaos Great Saints had no desire for resources because their own abilities had reached extremes, and no amount of resources could enhance their strength.

But Lin Yuan?

He was currently in a phase of strength enhancement, with constant practice of the “Infinite Void” Second Layer, his internal universe changing each day, and his desire for resources never stopped.

This is why he had the idea to take the black jade from the source world through the Myriad Realms Gate and sell it at high prices to those Chaos Great Saints.

The black jade, capable of enhancing the willpower of the heart, probably no Chaos Great Saint could resist, and they would go to any lengths to purchase it.

Compared to plundering through slaughter, Lin Yuan still preferred to acquire resources through peaceful trade.

“It’s just His Majesty Xuanhuang…”

Lin Yuan looked at the beast skin map, feeling reluctant. After all, how valuable must the inheritance of a supreme saint be, and how much cultivation time could it save him?

“Ask the Spirit of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm…”

Lin Yuan still wanted to understand more.

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Due to the cosmic collapse, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm was also affected, the originally vast secret realm world now reduced to a radius of a hundred meters.

Furthermore, the spirit of the secret realm had fallen into slumber.

The avatar Lin Yuan left here opened its eyes and began to call upon the spirit of the secret realm.

“Master.”

The six-armed figure of the spirit of the secret realm awoke from slumber, looking at Lin Yuan with a slight confusion.

With the universe now plunged into absolute silence, why was Lin Yuan waking it up at this time?

“Tell me about His Majesty Xuanhuang.” Lin Yuan immediately said.

“The matters regarding His Majesty?”

The six-armed figure blinked, cautiously asked, “Which aspect?”

“Weapons and treasures.” Lin Yuan said.

If His Majesty Xuanhuang truly fell into a time loop while attempting the thirteenth level, then his treasures and weapons would definitely be left in his resting palace, waiting for successors to claim.

After all, external forces have almost no effect on the attempt of the thirteenth level.

“Weapons ah…”

The six-armed figure thought for a moment, “Among His Majesty’s many weapons, the Seal of Xuanhuang is the most powerful. Under a single strike, ordinary Chaos Great Saints would be annihilated, unable to resist.”

“And then there’s the Armor of Xuanhuang, invulnerable to all laws, imperishable amidst tribulations. Wearing this armor, even supreme saints of the same level would find it difficult to inflict the slightest harm…”

Lin Yuan listened quietly, becoming increasingly tempted, as His Majesty Xuanhuang’s main battle weapons totaled six, each incredibly powerful, even among supreme saints there were very few able to match them.

“At that time, when His Majesty was still present, those supreme saints did not dare contend with His Majesty…” the six-armed figure said with a sigh.

Among the supreme saints, His Majesty Xuanhuang definitely belonged to the most powerful tier.

While supreme saints and Chaos Great Saints are both at the perfect state of the Chaos Realm.

But though their realms are the same, the power to fight and kill varies in strength.

“I understand.” Lin Yuan nodded.

“Master, what on earth has happened?”

The six-armed figure tentatively asked.

“The map on the beast skin…”

Lin Yuan briefly explained the matter.

“The universe developed by His Majesty has been discovered?”

The six-armed figure lamented.

If His Majesty Xuanhuang were still alive, no one could find the universe he developed.

Now that the universe has been discovered and besieged by all the saints and venerables, it means that His Majesty Xuanhuang indeed hasn’t appeared in the Chaos Void for a long time.

“Master, the weapons and treasures left by His Majesty should all belong to you.”

The six-armed figure looked at Lin Yuan and couldn’t help but say.

As the spirit of the secret realm created by His Majesty Xuanhuang, the six-armed figure naturally did not want to see His Majesty’s weapons and treasures fall into the hands of outsiders.

Lin Yuan, having taken over the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, is considered the heir of His Majesty, the rightful successor of that postnatal universe.

As for outsiders? Those venerables and saints coveting it?

In the eyes of the six-armed figure, they are intruders, plunderers!

“I will try my best.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

…

Starlight ‘Fragmented World’.

Lin Yuan pondered, considering the many possibilities of entering that postnatal universe.

In fact, there’s no need for much consideration; the biggest problem blocking Lin Yuan now is how to reach the vicinity of that postnatal universe in the shortest time.

If he can’t get there, everything is for naught.

“Hard, hard, hard.”

Lin Yuan mused for a while, unable to see much hope.

With the current understanding and mastery of the Eightfold Realm of Space-Time, it would take hundreds of years to reach the postnatal universe.

To arrive in a short time, perhaps a qualitative breakthrough in time perception is needed, like reaching the Ninth Realm of Space-Time?

But a breakthrough in time perception? It requires a lot of accumulation, and with Lin Yuan’s current perception, stepping into the Ninth Realm… it’s possible, but it would take time.

This leads to a dead-end loop.

“Relying solely on myself, it’s impossible to get there in a short time. But what if I rely on external forces?”

Lin Yuan shifted his thinking, silently considering.

For example, in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, wanting to travel from the capital to the edge domain, even a powerful Heavenly Venerate would need to perform millions of void traversals.

But with the ancient country’s space-time teleportation formation, it can be reached in just over ten breaths.

The space-time teleportation formation here is an external force.

“Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion…”

Lin Yuan looked towards the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

The Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion has branches throughout the Chaos Void; every Void Domain has a subdivision, and the Eye of Myriad Laws can descend upon any subdivision in an instant.

If the Eye of Myriad Laws is willing to help Lin Yuan, there’s hope to get there in a short time.

“Go and ask.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment, then immediately formed an incarnation and descended upon the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

Inside the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

As soon as Lin Yuan entered, he came to the deepest space.

The Pavilion Master of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion awaited Lin Yuan with a smile.

The last evaluation of Lin Yuan by the Eye of Myriad Laws was something he had memorized to this day.

A future thirteenth-order lifeform?

My heavens.

To be evaluated like that by the Eye of Myriad Laws, even those unparalleled Great Saints couldn’t achieve such a thing, right?

The unparalleled Great Saints are only a step away from the thirteenth order, but that step is like a chasm, almost impossible to cross.

“I want to see the Eye of Myriad Laws.”

Lin Yuan immediately said.

“Please wait a moment.”

The Pavilion Master of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion considered briefly before immediately starting to contact the Eye of Myriad Laws.

If other strong individuals came, directly requesting to see the Eye of Myriad Laws, the Pavilion Master wouldn’t bothered to respond.

The Eye of Myriad Laws is such an existence that you can’t just meet it upon request.

But Lin Yuan?

The Pavilion Master knew exactly what to do.

Before long.

Time and space slowly rotated, forming a whirlpool.

A massive eye condensed, gazing down upon Lin Yuan.

“What’s the matter with me?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at Lin Yuan with interest.

“I want to go here.”

Lin Yuan didn’t beat around the bush, directly stating the space-time coordinates.

“Hmm?”

“What’s your relationship with that young Xuan Huang?”

The Eye of Myriad Laws expressed surprise in its tone, staring at Lin Yuan for a moment.

That young Xuan Huang… Lin Yuan pondered and immediately understood that the Eye of Myriad Laws was referring to His Majesty Xuanhuang.

His Majesty Xuanhuang is incredibly ancient. Not to mention this era, even in the time of the Moyu Tower Master, few powerful individuals were aware of him.

But the Eye of Myriad Laws clearly knows His Majesty Xuanhuang well, even calling him ‘that kid’.

“I have inherited part of the legacy left by His Majesty Xuanhuang.”

Lin Yuan didn’t hide, he spoke directly.

As an unparalleled Great Saint, His Majesty Xuanhuang had opened 33,333 Xuanhuang Secret Realms as his legacy grounds.

“No wonder.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws suddenly understood.

“That young Xuan Huang is a pity. If he weren’t trapped by his Heart Demon, there would have been a slim hope for him to become the thirteenth-order.” The Eye of Myriad Laws muttered to itself, clearly recalling something.

“Heart Demon?”

Lin Yuan listened from the side.

This was the first time he had heard such a statement; even the Spirit of the Secret Realm didn’t know.

“From the twelfth order to impact the thirteenth, the most taboo thing is the obsession with Heart Demons. Because the time loop you fall into will change according to your weaknesses, your mental state must be absolutely perfect to have a chance to endure. If there is an obsession with a Heart Demon? The time loop will revolve according to the obsession with the Heart Demon, making escape almost impossible.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws explained.

“I see.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

However, he was puzzled.

Even such an unparalleled Great Saint as His Majesty Xuanhuang had something he couldn’t see through? Otherwise, how could an obsession with the Heart Demon form?

“Alright.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws gazed at Lin Yuan and said, “You came to me, wanting me to teleport you to the vicinity of that postnatal universe?”

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

“Quite favorably asking for assistance.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws showed a hint of amusement in its eyes, “But I have agreed.”
